section_path: Conjunctiva (excluding Retinoblastoma, Malignant Melanoma, Kaposi Sarcoma, and Lymphoma)
text:
C690  Conjunctiva

**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Carcinoma of Conjunctiva,* pages 276-278.
* TNM is defined for this site; however, there is no stage group

**Note 2:**  Laterality must be coded for this site.

**Note 3:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Conjunctiva* chapter on page 257 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=257).
